sampling_determinism.consequence: The three repetitions are session identities, not seeds. Each repetition is a matched pair sharing byte-identical configuration, so comparison is valid WITHIN a pair. Across repetitions the runs are three independent stochastic samples and must not be averaged into a determinism claim; at n=3 the variance is expected and unquantified.
